summary_1line: Vyasa counsels grieving Yudhishthira on expiation through sacrifices and begins recounting the lineage and story leading to the wealthy king Marutta.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vyasa speaks solemnly to the sorrowful Yudhishthira seated amid the aftermath of war, urging him to perform great sacrifices for purification.
The impoverished king blows into his cupped hand, and from it a miraculous army appears to defend his kingdom.
Vyasa describes hidden gold left by Brahmanas in the snowy Himalayas after the grand sacrifice of King Marutta.
